content: संकेतः .²1 An intimation, allusion. .²2 A sign, gesture, hint; <ls>Mu. 1</ls>. .²3 An indicatory sign, mark, token. .²4 Agreement, convention; संकेतो गृह्यते जातौ गुणद्रव्यक्रियासु च <ls>S. D. 12</ls>. .²5 Engagement, appointment, assignation (made by a mistress or lover); नामसमेतं कृतसंकेतं वादयते मृदु वेणुम् <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>. .²6 A place of meeting (for lovers), rendezvous; सा स्वैरिण्येकदा कान्तं संकेतम् उपनेष्यति <ls>Bhāg. 11. 8. 23</ls>; कान्तार्थिनी तु या याति संकेतं साभिसारिका <ls>Ak.</ls> .²7 Condition, provision. .²8 A short explanatory rule (in <ab>gram.</ab>).
